# Optional audited external baselines

The public repository does not copy third-party source trees. To inspect or rerun the forecasting-baseline audit, clone the original projects here and check out the audited revisions:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/thuml/Time-Series-Library.git
git -C Time-Series-Library checkout 4e938a1767106324dd753b2a44832bf870a0252e

git clone https://github.com/ServiceNow/N-BEATS.git
git -C N-BEATS checkout c746a4f13ffc957487e0c3279b182c3030836053
```

The original repositories and their licenses remain controlling. CARO-RUL's MIT license does not relicense third-party material.
